verses.he: שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲלֹ֥ות אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי׃
verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ أَرْفَعُ عَيْنَيَّ إِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ، مِنْ حَيْثُ يَأْتِي عَوْنِي!
verses.en: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: from whence shall my help come?
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees. I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

verses.he: עֶ֭זְרִי מֵעִ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: مَعُونَتِي مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱلرَّبِّ، صَانِعِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.en: My help cometh from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.kjv: My help [cometh] from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
verses.web: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

verses.ar: لَا يَدَعُ رِجْلَكَ تَزِلُّ. لَا يَنْعَسُ حَافِظُكَ.
verses.en: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved; He that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.kjv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.web: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

verses.he: הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא־יָ֭נוּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שֹׁ֝ומֵ֗ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: إِنَّهُ لَا يَنْعَسُ وَلَا يَنَامُ حَافِظُ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: Behold, He that keepeth Israel doth neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.kjv: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.web: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.he: יְהוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל־יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ حَافِظُكَ. ٱلرَّبُّ ظِلٌّ لَكَ عَنْ يَدِكَ ٱلْيُمْنَى.
verses.en: The LORD is thy keeper; the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] thy keeper: the LORD [is] thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.web: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

verses.ar: لَا تَضْرِبُكَ ٱلشَّمْسُ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ، وَلَا ٱلْقَمَرُ فِي ٱللَّيْلِ.
verses.en: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.kjv: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.web: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يَحْفَظُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ. يَحْفَظُ نَفْسَكَ.
verses.en: The LORD shall keep thee from all evil; He shall keep thy soul.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.web: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يَحْفَظُ خُرُوجَكَ وَدُخُولَكَ مِنَ ٱلْآنَ وَإِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.en: The LORD shall guard thy going out and thy coming in, from this time forth and for ever.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.web: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
